('''CDSL''') is an Indian [[central securities depository]], founded in 1999.{{Cite news |title=CDSL demat accounts, which began its operations in 1999, cross 2.5 crore mark |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/banking/cdsl-demat-accounts-which-began-its-operations-in-1999-cross-2-5-crore-mark/articleshow/77892925.cms |access-date=2022-06-08}} CDSL is the largest depository in India in terms of the number of [[demat account]]s opened. In February 2022, CDSL became the first depository in India to open 60 million active demat accounts.{{Cite news |title=CDSL becomes first depository to open 6 crore active demat accounts |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/cdsl-becomes-first-depository-to-open-6-crore-active-demat-accounts/articleshow/89918642.cms |access-date=2022-06-08}} As of March 2022, the depository holds assets worth {{INR}}37.2 trillion,{{Cite news |last=Sethuraman |first=Sundar |date=2022-04-14 |title=Demat account tally jumps 63% to 89.7 million in FY22, shows data |work=Business Standard India |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/markets/india-s-demat-account-tally-up-63-to-89-7-million-in-fy22-shows-data-122041401088_1.html |access-date=2022-06-08}} with over 580 [[depository participant]]s associated with CDSL.{{Cite web |title=Make It Mandatory for Brokers To Subscribe to CDSL's Easiest Facility To Transfer Shares: Retail Investors |url=https://www.moneylife.in/article/make-it-mandatory-for-brokers-to-subscribe-to-cdsls-easiest-facility-to-transfer-shares-retail-investors/66920.html |access-date=2022-06-08 |website=Moneylife NEWS & VIEWS |language=en}} == History == In February 1999, CDSL received certificate of commencement of business from [[Securities and Exchange Board of India]] (SEBI).{{Cite web |title=SEBI {{!}} Certificate of commencement of business granted to CDSL |url=https://www.sebi.gov.in/media/press-releases/feb-1999/certificate-of-commencement-of-business-granted-to-cdsl_21712.html |access-date=2022-06-08 |website=www.sebi.gov.in}} On 30 June 2017, CDSL was listed on the National Stock Exchange (NSE) through [[initial public offering]] (IPO){{Cite web |title=Bumper Listing: CDSL debuts at Rs 250; zooms 80% over issue price |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/ipo/bumper-listing-cdsl-debuts-at-rs-250-zooms-80-over-issue-price-2315323.html |access-date=2022-06-08 |website=Moneycontrol |language=en}} making it the first depository in Asia-Pacific region and only the second depository in the world to get listed. CDSL was initially promoted by [[Bombay Stock Exchange|BSE Limited]]. extract:
Central Depository Services (India) Ltd. (CDSL) is an Indian central securities depository, founded in 1999.
CDSL is the largest depository in India in terms of the number of demat accounts opened. In February 2022, CDSL became the first depository in India to open 60 million active demat accounts. As of March 2022, the depository holds assets worth ₹37.2 trillion, with over 580 depository participants associated with CDSL.
